name: Ai Touch ~Aiyoku Mamire no Lolikko~
original_name: 亜衣タッチ～愛欲まみれのロリっ娘～
source:
A girl named Ai has moved to the house in front of the main character's house.
She attaches herself to the main character and visits him from time to time.
Gradually, he starts to have a growing desire in him...
